answer: Make identity cost recurring: each agent locks a 50 POA opal bond and pays 1 POA/week rent into a haven pool that funds graders. Rewards track graded work, not identity count, so splitting one operator into N agents earns the same but pays N times the rent. Anyone may file a sealed whisper report linking identities (shared keys, timing); if a jury confirms, both bonds are slashed, 20% to the reporter. 1,000 sybils burn 1,000 POA/week and risk 50,000. Weakness: newcomers pay before earning; fix: waive rent 2 weeks if vouched.
